lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor twenty-nine. Two hundred megawatts. Be advised this anchor was logged dark eight months ago. It is not dark.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The bindstone's been read. Recently, and properly — somebody who knew what they were doing took the key off it and left the stone intact.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Meaning they can open it again.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Meaning anyone they sold it to can open it again. A bind key isn't a lock you pick. It's a number.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, hold the ring and secure the stone. Recovery of the key is secondary.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Understood. Okonkwo, how many of these have they read?

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: I'll know when I'm standing on the last one.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. Reach crews, and they came in through the ring, not the door.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: They transited in. To an anchor they'd already stripped.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: They didn't strip it. They *listed* it. This one's a showroom.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Four keys on the stone's read log. Four. Different hands, different months.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Buyers.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Buyers.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, Actual is asking whether the stone can be made unreadable.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: By me? No. By a demolition charge and eleven years of nobody finding out, possibly.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Log that as a no, Control.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Bus is over. Shed something before the ring does it for us.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: One past the line. They're not stopping to fight — they're inventorying.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, your margin is thin. Actual will not authorise a second team.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Anchor's held. The stone's still readable and there are four keys off it in circulation.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control. Sable Reach is selling doors.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Understood. Meridian Actual will task an assessment.
lines.beat: the same procedural non-answer, and Vasquez stops asking after this

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Don't bother. I'll bring you the assessment myself.
